props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default, ra precedence (seeds only into an untouched hole).

props.name: format
props.comment: Read transform (raw form value → input value).

props.name: helperText
props.comment: Helper text rendered below the input; a string is translated.

props.name: id
props.comment: Explicit element id; a generated `useId` value is used otherwise.

props.name: isRequired
props.comment: Forces the required marker; ORed with `required()` detection on `validate`.

props.name: label
props.comment:
The input label. A string is translated; a ReactNode renders as-is;
`false` (or `""`) renders no label.

props.name: name
props.comment: Legacy field-name alias (ra parity); the wiring uses `source`.

props.name: onBlur
props.comment: Chained AFTER the blur is recorded.

props.name: onChange
props.comment: Chained AFTER the parsed value is written to the form.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Override the ambient resource (used to resolve the default label key).

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path RELATIVE to the ambient source scope.

props.name: type
props.comment: The DOM input `type` (text inputs default to `"text"`).

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
